CTA Research: Training Technologies
← Back to Training Technologies

Equity Valuation Tool

The intrinsic value calculator suite CTA Research uses internally — now live on the site, tool by tool. Educational tools for the Pro Equity Research Program, not financial advice.

1. Quality Scorecard

Score ROE, Debt/Equity, Margin, EPS Growth, Dividend Track Record & BV Growth Consistency to see if the business is worth valuing.

2. BV Growth & Stability Chart

Step 1: Current BV/Share, prior BV/Share & years → CAGR. Step 1b: plot up to 10 years of BVPS with R² trend check to confirm it's stable enough for a DCF.

3. DCF Calculator

Project future book value and dividends, discount back to today's value, and get a BUY/HOLD/OVERVALUED call vs. market price.

4. FCFF Calculator

Enterprise Value DCF for growth/capital-intensive names — projects Unlevered FCFF, discounts at WACC, solves EV → Equity Value → per share.

5. Relative Valuation (Comps)

Value a company against up to 5 peers using P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/B and P/S — cross-check against your DCF/FCFF number.

6. Sum-of-the-Parts (SOTP)

Value each business segment separately, then add them up, for multi-segment companies like Tesla, Amazon or Naspers.

7. Sensitivity Table

See how Intrinsic Value / Share swings across a grid of discount rate and growth rate assumptions — a heatmap view of your valuation's key risk.

8. Reverse Calculator

Flip the FCFF model around: feed in today's market price and solve for the revenue growth rate the market is already pricing in.

Ticker™

You're an analyst against 3 AI rivals. Roll, buy stocks, dig into full research reports, answer valuation & compliance questions, and try to get promoted by the PM. The whole point is to build the analyst mindset — reading fundamentals, catalysts, financials, valuation, comps and technicals — before you commit to a position. CTA Research: Training Technologies

Sensitivity Table

Every DCF-style valuation lives or dies on two assumptions: your discount rate and your growth rate. This grid uses the Gordon Growth (perpetuity) model — Value = Cash Flow × (1+g) ÷ (r − g) — to show how Intrinsic Value / Share moves as those two assumptions shift around your base case.

A. Base Case Inputs

B. Intrinsic Value / Share Grid

Rows = Discount Rate, Columns = Growth Rate. Centre cell (bold border) is your base case. If a price is entered, cells are shaded green (undervalued) or magenta (overvalued) by margin of safety.

Base Case Intrinsic Value / Share
—
Base Case Margin of Safety
—

The perpetuity model breaks down when the discount rate is at or below the growth rate — those cells show "n/a". Educational tool only, not financial advice. CTA Research (Pty) Ltd · Johannesburg.

CTA Research | Analyst Laboratory

The Analyst Laboratory

Research first. Presentation second. Capital last. Every analyst proves it in a written report and a live pitch before they ever trade a cent of Lab money.

Apply to the Lab

Our Thesis

The Analyst Laboratory is CTA Research’s proprietary trading division. We do not manage client money and we do not sell tips — we trade our own capital and build analysts.

The Lab exists to prove that disciplined equity research holds up under real accountability. Every analyst is judged on the quality of their thinking — on paper and out loud — long before they’re judged on a P&L.

How It Works

  1. Research Report — Analysts write a full equity research report on a company of their choosing: business description, industry positioning, valuation, financial analysis, risks and ESG.
  2. Voice Presentation — Analysts record a 5-minute-plus pitch presenting and defending their investment thesis.
  3. Formal Evaluation — Both the report and the pitch are scored by CTA Research against a fixed standard before anything else happens.
  4. Capital Deployment — Only analysts who pass both stages are approved to trade Lab capital, under defined risk limits.

Research reporting comes first. Presentation comes second. Trading is the reward for getting the first two right — not the starting point.

For Analysts

You get:

  1. Capital: Trade the firm’s book, not your savings, once you’re approved
  2. Structured Feedback: Formal scoring on every report and every pitch
  3. Framework: Market Degree® training through the PM(SA) curriculum
  4. Recognition: Performance-based upside tied to your track record

We expect:

  1. Original Work: Your report and pitch are your own, properly researched
  2. Radical Honesty: Losses are studied, not hidden
  3. Community: Time given back teaching Academy students

Access: Private facility. Invite-only. No walk-ins.

For Academy Students

The Lab funds your tuition. Every loss we take becomes a case study you learn from. Top Academy performers get invited to submit a report and pitch for Lab consideration.

Join Research Club: Get access to Morning & Monthly Meetings for R199.99/3 months. Learn alongside in-house analysts.

Join The Laboratory

We hire for character, train for skill.

Requirements:

  1. PM(SA) Level 2 complete
  2. Submit a written equity research report
  3. Record a 5-minute-plus voice presentation/pitch defending it
  4. Pass CTA Research’s formal evaluation of both
